name: Deru Trees of Marae Lassel
title: Deru Trees of Marae Lassel
summary: The three talking Deru Trees (Skuld, Urd and Verdandi) on the north-east Marescent Plateau at 51.9N 72.7W, which T'thuun assaulted. They are giant 'Tall Tree' NPC weenies (setup 0x020003A1 at scale 0.8, so about 50 m tall with crowns about 25 m across) at (6998,36922), (6998,36904) and (7021,36926), on an olthoi-ground rise at z 134. FX emitters run up their trunks. Ferns, a mossy diamond rock, T'thuun tentacles and eyestalks, and insect remains surround them, and Marae invasion generators are nearby. The trees are ACE entities, so the kit does not model them; their clearance below is computed by hand.

site.notes: Derived @teleloc on open olthoi ground 40 m south-east of the three Deru trees (ground 125.3, >= 8 m from the nearest rock and pine); the gazetteer's nearest outdoor entry is the Ancient Empyrean Grotto portal 183 m north.

shots.standingOrder: A traveller's eyes 33 m south of the three Deru trees, looking up their 50 m trunks into the crowns while creeping 3 m forward; keep 25 m from every trunk, the ferns stay below the frame.
shots.notes: POV of discovery. A traveller's eyes (1.66 m) stand 33 m south of the three Deru trees, look 24 deg up into their crowns and creep 3 m forward with a slight gait. The subject is the camera, so the subject-in-frame figure is 0 % by design. The kit's projection of the three crowns (z 159-160) gives 100 % in frame over the take and the window (proj.mjs: NDC x -0.30 to +0.31, y +0.25 to +0.81). The nearest trunk is 25 m away, 13 m outside its crown. shots.notes: Orbit. The camera circles 36 deg clockwise from west-south-west to west, 70 m out and 40 m above the trees' base (z 174, 14 m above the default canopy).
